newsitem.title: USA: Artra Group unit renegotiates loan pact.
newsitem.headline: Artra Group unit renegotiates loan pact.

text.p: Bagcraft Corp of America, a subsidiary of Artra Group Inc, said Thursday it has renegotiated its senior loan facility with General Electric Capital Corp for an additional five years.

The company said the new $38-million credit facility is expected to save Bagcraft $600,000 in annual interest expense. Bagcraft President Mark Santacrose added that the company will also gain the financial strength and flexibility for both internal expansion and further acquisitons.
Bagcraft makes flexible packaging and wraps. Artra Group has operations in the packaging and chemical industries.
